info.title: Shopclass REST API
info.description: JSON over HTTPS. Send a credential as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`: `sck_...` for an admin's or a user's key, `scp_...` for a public key, which only reads public data (it may also go in `?api_key=` on a GET), or `sca_...`, a signed-in user's access token from POST /auth/token. Writes accept an `Idempotency-Key` header. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents. A cookie alone never authenticates a call: theme JavaScript on the site's own pages sends the signed-in user's page token in `X-Shopclass-Token` with the sign-in cookie.

code.description: A stable machine-readable code. New codes may be added, so treat an unknown one as its HTTP status.

total.description: Matches across every page; null unless the request sent count=true, and on a page reached by a keyset cursor or a location list.

truncated.description: Present and true when more matches exist but paging stops here: links.next is null. Narrow the filters, or sort by created or id.

next.description: The next page; null on the last one.
Null: the list is whole. A later version may page it, so follow next when it is set.

original.description: Only when the site keeps original images.

value.description: Text, a number, a boolean (checkbox), an RFC 3339 time (date) or {from, to} (date interval).

locale.description: The locale the title and description are in.

price.description: Null when the listing has no price or its category does not show prices.

email.description: Null unless the seller shows it; always sent to the owner and admins.

phone.description: Shown as the theme shows it, unless the site hides it from the API.

expires_at.description: Null when the listing never expires. RFC 3339, UTC.

approved.description: Admin view: false while it waits for moderation.

scope.description: Scopes to ask for, space separated; every user scope when left out.

current_password.description: The account's password, asked again before a key is made.

confirmed.description: False until the link in the activation e-mail is opened.

owner.description: The admin or user it acts for.

token.description: Only in the answer that makes the key. It is not stored, so keep it.

kind.description: admin by default; a public key only reads public data.

scopes.description: Only scopes the calling key holds.

expires_at.description: The last day it works, or a number of days such as 90d; never when left out.

dead_letters.description: Jobs that stopped retrying, newest first.

status.description: paused: switched off after 8 failed deliveries in a row.

last_status.description: The last delivery's answer: "HTTP <code>", "Timed out", "Could not connect", or why the address was refused.

previous_secret_until.description: While set, deliveries carry a second signature with the secret a rotation replaced. RFC 3339, UTC.

secret.description: Only in the answer that makes the endpoint or rotates its secret. Keep it: it is not shown again.

url.description: http or https, on port 80 or 443. A private network address only while Settings -> API allows it.

enabled.description: true also clears a pause and the failure count.

message_id.description: The webhook-id the ping is sent with.

status.description: error: gave up after the last try.

deliveries.description: Newest first. A delivery that got a 2xx answer leaves the queue.

schema.description: The component schema of the event's data.

id.description: The same as the webhook-id header.

thin.description: Present and true when the body was too big, or the listing or comment is not live: data then holds only id and url, and live: false when it is not live.

ETag.description: The answer's version. Send it back in If-None-Match for a 304, or in If-Match on a PATCH or DELETE. A PATCH sent with If-Match answers with the new one.

RateLimit.description: The tightest limit this call counted against: its name, requests left (r) and seconds to reset (t).

RateLimit-Policy.description: Every limit this call counted against.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again.

Location.description: The new resource, or where it moved.

Request-Id.description: An id for this call. Quote it when asking for support.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: true on an answer replayed for a repeated Idempotency-Key.

bearer.description: An API key (`sck_<id>.<secret>`, `scp_<id>.<secret>`) or an access token (`sca_...`). The scopes an operation needs are listed in its security requirement and in `x-scope`.

publicKey.name: api_key
publicKey.description: A public key (`scp_...`) on a GET, for pages that cannot set a header.

pageSession.name: X-Shopclass-Token
pageSession.description: Same-site session: a page token (`scs_...`) from osc_api_session_token(), sent with the web sign-in cookie by JavaScript on the site's own pages. No CORS, never `account:write` or admin scopes.
